features.title: Grown here
features.body: Most of what we cook comes from the garden or from farms within an hour of the hotel.

features.title: No timetable
features.body: Breakfast until noon, late check-out on request and the pools open until midnight.

features.title: Looked after
features.body: One host looks after you from your first email to the drive back to the airport.

features.title: Off the map
features.body: Walks, boats and bikes to the places our team goes on their days off.
